designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt abolished the Bear River National Forest and made part of it the Cache National Forest in Idaho and Utah.
designationHistory.note: The executive order text was not located online; FS-612 and the WPA list agree on EO 802 of May 26, 1908, and Davis gives the effective date, July 1, 1908. Bear River Forest Reserve had been created May 28, 1906 from the Logan Forest Reserve (May 29, 1903) and other land.
